steps.title: Steam the broccoli
steps.body: Steam until tender and then place **1–2 heads broccoli** in greased 9×12 pan.

steps.title: Cook the chicken
steps.body: Cook, lightly season, and dice **1 pound chicken**.

steps.title: Make the sauce
steps.body: Combine **1 can cream of chicken soup**, **1 cup Miracle Whip**, **2 tsp lemon juice** and **1 tsp ground curry** in a separate bowl, then add the cooked chicken.

steps.title: Assemble
steps.body: Pour chicken mixture over broccoli, and top with croutons.

steps.title: Bake
steps.body: Bake until warm (about 45 min) at 350°F and serve over rice.
